input_contract: Implement DSClosure init/call with shared, mutable and once modes. The concrete body performs checked int addition of capture and argument. Shared keeps capture, mutable stores a successful result, and once consumes on the first admitted attempt even if arithmetic fails. Add a typed closure holding a borrowed array slice and a once closure owning a synthetic resource with a no-fail release callback. Define capture lifetime, allowed invocation and failure cleanup explicitly for each.
expected: Capture3 shared calls with2 return5 repeatedly without capture mutation. Mutable calls return5 then7. Once capture1 with2 returns3 and later DS_EMPTY. Once INT_MAX with1 returns DS_RANGE with unchanged output and becomes inactive.
independent_oracle: Enumerate captures/arguments-4..4 for all modes, retain mode/state/output after every call, then test int extrema. In the resource variant inject rejection before and after invocation admission and count release exactly once. Do not dereference ended borrowed storage; use an instrumented lifetime token to demonstrate rejection and separately analyze the raw-pointer counterexample.
